recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-3230; any future review of historical QUICK model example names should be handled under a separate issue rather than the original Questionnaire split.
issue_request: FHIR-3230 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested splitting the original Questionnaire concept into two resources, one for the form/design and one for completed questionnaire data, with the accepted names Questionnaire and QuestionnaireAnswers.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly cites FHIR-3230, but commit 54ddc30bbb4ff904ff5e5c0f7cce9088b15b19c6 from 2014-05-13 says it split Questionnaire into two, added QuestionnaireAnswers source files, and updated Questionnaire. This matches the Jira request and appears to be the historical application.
additional_context: FHIR-8480 later renamed QuestionnaireAnswers to QuestionnaireResponse in commit c51b8682420300c0f51dd0ad260d0be7f5ae20ab/SVN #6162. Current source/fhir.ini has active entries for Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse and no active QuestionnaireAnswers resource. FHIR-12172 is already represented on the combined branch and corrected remaining current-build stale response wording; remaining QuestionnaireAnswers strings are an alias, release history, or QUICK model example content.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because the current build already has the intended two-resource model and the current name QuestionnaireResponse is the result of a later accepted rename.

related_jiras.note: Renamed the completed-answer resource from QuestionnaireAnswers to QuestionnaireResponse after the FHIR-3230 split. It was used as context, not decided in this seed audit.
